sponsoredBills.summary: Establishes a Prescription Drug Price Regulatory Commission to recommend fair prices for approved prescription drugs, with the Secretary of Health and Human Services setting and publishing those prices. Prohibits selling drugs above the established fair price and authorizes civil penalties and Federal Trade Commission enforcement.
sponsoredBills.title: Regulate the Price of All Drugs Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to impose an excise tax on crude oil exceeding $75 per barrel and distribute collected revenues to individual taxpayers as rebates until hostilities with Iran cease, the Strait of Hormuz reopens, and oil prices fall below $75 per barrel.
sponsoredBills.title: Iran War Oil Crisis Windfall Profits Tax Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Foreign Affairs.

sponsoredBills.summary: Prohibits exports of crude oil, gasoline, and diesel fuel during military operations against Iran, unless the President waives the prohibition for crude oil that cannot be efficiently refined domestically, requiring it be refined abroad and reimported.
sponsoredBills.title: Stop Oil Exports to Lower Gas Prices Act

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Ways and Means.

sponsoredBills.summary: Amends the Internal Revenue Code to establish a free, government-owned online tax preparation and filing program accessible to eligible taxpayers, prohibit IRS agreements restricting such services, and require states to integrate state income tax filing with the federal program.
sponsoredBills.title: Direct File Act of 2026

sponsoredBills.summary: Access to Small Business Investor Capital Act This bill allows a registered investment company to exclude from the calculation of acquired fund fees and expenses those incurred indirectly from investment in a business development company. Acquired fund fees and expenses is a required line item on a fund's fee schedule that provides the operating expenses of the fund.
sponsoredBills.title: Access to Small Business Investor Capital Act
